description: Somos un equipo del Colegio North Schools de Punta del este, de 3ro de Primaria
summary:
WHY SPACE ANIMALS MATTER

Pioneers
Many kids don't know that brave animals traveled to space before human astronauts!

The Problem
History books can feel boring or hard to read for young students.

Our Goal
We wanted to tell the true story of space animal pioneers in a fun, interactive way.
details: Our project is created in the Scratch programming environment and features three animals sent into space aboard a spacecraft; they simulate a journey and discuss the various challenges that might arise while traveling together.
dataRefs: A brief history of animals in space
